notes.title: Milfy Cases .019 Reboot 2nd Update English Only
notes.notes: [p]Hey there, I'm back with another update.[/p][p]Before I get into the details, allow me to apologize for not yet localizing the new version of the game into other languages. I'll be doing that in the next week or so, which will include the .018 and the content of the .019 update editions. [/p][p][b]So what's in the game this time? Here is the summary:[/b][/p][list][*][p]7,100+ words in this edition, bringing the total in the reboot to over 12,000+ - we're about a quarter of the way, in terms of story, to match the prior edition before the reboot.[/p][/*][*][p]471 images in the game, and then another 20 images that are part of the achievements feature.[/p][/*][*][p]Four new in-game achievements and associated screens.[/p][/*][*][p]One new lore entry (If you see something that deserves a lore entry, I'm happy to add that as well, feel free to contact me here or discord, etc).[/p][/*][*][p]Two new character profiles for Sally and Alice, both of whom make their debut in this version of the game, which now includes all of the major, primary love interests. There will be some secondary characters & possible encounters with them, but the primary love interests for Milfy Cases are the ones in this episode, eg, Mary, Jenny, Sally, and Alice.[/p][/*][*][p]No new animation this time, but we do have 28 new audio files, including 1 new song and 27 sound effects. Also, I've cleaned up more of the legacy audio files to shrink the size of the game, so it's not bloated with old stuff that's not part of the current, new experience.[/p][/*][*][p]A bug fix related to the maxlovescore with Zara from the prior edition of the game.[/p][/*][/list][p]As you could see from the .018, Winthrope Manor is a very large house, which is why Mary has not one but two maids helping her maintain the property. In this episode, we see more of the manor and we'll see even more as the story unfolds. Also, finally see Hope Springs and a few key business locations in the next update, expected to be ready at the end of September.[/p][p]Thanks for playing,[/p][p]Brosef Chungus[/p]

notes.title: Milfy Cases .018 Reboot - English Edition Available
notes.notes: [p]Hey there-[/p][p][/p][p]First, I'll have the machine translations available in the next week for this update. I ran out of time, and rather than ship later than planned, I wanted to share the English version now, and then next week, we'll have the other languages available as well. [/p][p][/p][p]So what's in this version? Well, we're starting over (mostly), and as a result, you'll be playing from the beginning, but with a revamped story, locations, and more.[/p][list][*][p]5,100 words of story - it's a reboot, so the story begins from scratch, which I think you'll love.[/p][/*][*][p]580+ images in full HD - all new created for this edition[/p][/*][*][p]34 animations, including a sexy scene that's available in the replay gallery[/p][/*][*][p]In-game achievements for selecting various options in the game which unlock special renders, easily accessible from the Menu in the upper left as you play.[/p][/*][*][p]Lore entries as you explore the story will unlock, giving you extra details that flesh out the story without cluttering up the narrative with too many walls of text.[/p][/*][*][p]A replay gallery (only the one entry, for now) where you can revisit the sexy scenes in game anytime after they're unlocked.[/p][/*][*][p]Three types of menu choices where you can customize Scott Thunderstone's personality - or rename him if you wish early in the game as you being the adventure.[/p][/*][*][p]Multiple brand new, customized environments created by both myself & my partner over the past month of work to bring you some of the best set design I think we've ever done.[/p][/*][*][p]Aside from Scott, characters from the prior edition in this episode include Detective Jenny and Mary.[/p][/*][/list][p]I have a lot of plans for the future updates, which should be monthly, or close to it, from now on since this project is now occupying all of my game development time.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for your support, and I hope you enjoy.[/p][p]Best,[/p][p]Brosef Chungus [/p]

notes.title: .017 Bugfix and idle animation update
notes.notes:
Hi all-

After multiple rounds of feedback for both Milfy Cases and the revamped Horny Holiday, I've updated all the idle animations in Milfy Cases to match the better received game. 

Additionally, there were numerous bug fixes including a few images that weren't correct for idle animations, the wrong speaker for a few lines of dialogue, and other minor audio improvements made for this update. 

Cheers,
Brosef

notes.title: .017 Bug Fix Edition
notes.notes:
Thanks to generous people on Discord, I've had numerous reports with bugs, and instructions on how to fix them, so here we are, including a new default audio setting, some continuity dialogue issues, and a list of image bugs. All fixed. 

Cheers,
Brosef

notes.title: Fixed typos in latest chapter
notes.notes: Two typos were found, both fixed. Thank you!

notes.title: Did you hear the one about the wizard, Chad? Let me tell you a story
notes.notes:
Hey there-

Thanks for tuning in, we've made some major changes to the game from the very beginning, all the way through to the newest episode. Previously, the story didn't have enough coherence...and since the main character uses magic from the very beginning, let's make him a wizard from a far away land, in the regular world for the the first time.

There's even more in the story, but the highlights for this build include the following:
[list]
[*] About six thousand words of new story, including the revamped prologue, editorial changes throughout, and of course, the latest chapter.
[*] 
[*] 250+ images, including a few animations
[*] 
[*] 90+ new audio files...yes, that's right, there's the most audio I've ever added to a single update, since I went and retooled everything from the very beginning. I believe this makes it far more immersive, but you tell me.
[*] 
[*] Last but not least, spelling, grammar, and other fixes from the beginning, which were more than a few, and an image or two that wasn't right, etc.
[/list]

I'm optimistic the updates make the experience far more enjoyable and entertaining.

Cheers,
Brosef Chungus

notes.title: .016 Minor Update, new opacity slider feature
notes.notes:
Hi all-

This was due to some reported issues on Discord (thank you all!) with an audio sound, updated; and the new preferences page feature of an opacity slider to change how much or little transparency there is in the text box background. Also a spelling issue from a prior update.

Thanks,
Brosef

notes.title: Milfy Cases .016 Edition
notes.notes:
[b]What's in the update? [/b]
Other than the continuation of the story, I've had some personal issues that resulted in things being delayed longer than expected for this update. Life, unfortunately, doesn't always conform to our desires.

[list]
[*] 197 new images
[*] Multiple new sound effects
[*] More story across multiple scenes
[*] An animated sexy scene with the first vaginal intercourse in the game. 
[*] All animated scenes converted to Webm from the previous frame animations which should result in better quality, less lag, and a better experience
[/list]

Please enjoy, feedback welcome as always.

notes.title: Bug fixes for .015
notes.notes: Multiple updates reported here & elsewhere including but not limited to the audio issues and text edits. All wav files were transcoded into ogg to hopefully prevent some of those issues for this build & will make a note for the future.

notes.title: Milfy Cases .015 Edition Release Notes
notes.notes:
It's finally here! Without further ado, go play the update...but if you want to read what's in it first, here you go:

[list]
[*] 224 images
[*] 15 plus songs & new audio effects
[*] About 4,500 or so words of brand new story
[*] 20 new animations
[*] Three different animated scenes, two of which vary depending on your choices, so to see both, you'd have to play twice with one of the variables from...much earlier in the game.
[*] Spelling, grammar, other edits & bug fixes since the last update

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Milfy Cases .014 Edition
notes.notes:
Hey there, handsome, thanks for being a fan! I've got great news, the .014 edition is finally ready. Here's the highlights of this update and I'll be around anytime for bug fixes, etc, while I start working on the next episode. Cheers!

[list]
[*] Improvements to the intro, beginning text, and more changes in the first few updates as I scrubbed for poor quality audio, story improvements, and more.
[*] About four thousand new words of story
[*] 211 new high quality images
[*] Eight different animations, one in a kissing scene, and another smaller animation elsewhere
[*] 34 new sound effects, bringing the total to 113, vs the previous edition total of 79
[*] Multiple new scenes, solid character development, and story continuity improvements to ensure that the narrative is consistent where there was some issues with the job referring to his losing it before with the various characters.
[/list]

notes.title: July 4th Update
notes.notes: Hey there, the new update has over 200 new images, 19 animations, four new songs, and almost ten new sound effects. There's a full six thousand words of new story as well, bringing the total to over twenty thousand words in this edition. Last but not least, there are two new achievements as well.

notes.title: English language customization fix
notes.notes: Patched error for English language name customization for the character Sally. Other languages did not have this issue - likewise, if you skipped customization & used the defaults in English, you shouldn't have seen this bug - it's been fixed either way.

notes.title: Milfy Cases: Damsels in Distress Launches May 25th, 2023
notes.notes:
Dive into the enthralling prologue and immerse yourself in the first two captivating chapters of Milfy Cases: Damsels in Distress. This thrilling narrative gives you the chance to intimately acquaint yourself with the central characters. Peel back the layers of intrigue as you uncover the enigmatic mystery that binds them all. Marvel at the unexpected delight and puzzlement of awakening in an unfamiliar forest, with your only immediate companion being an irate squirrel.

This riveting journey is the latest masterpiece from Big Chungus Productions, and we couldn't be more thrilled to invite you along. Your engagement and curiosity will make this adventure all the more memorable. We're genuinely excited to welcome you aboard for what promises to be a rollercoaster ride of emotions, suspense, and unanticipated turns. Strap in and prepare for a narrative experience like no other.
